results.text: Only open PRE_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY or EXCEPTION shipments enter active triage. Consistent DELIVERED/CANCELLED shipments have no active V1 exceptions. Validate global context/status first. Stop at human review; never contact carriers, modify shipments or approve actions.

Use only LATE_DELIVERY, STALE_TRACKING and FAILED_ATTEMPT_ADDRESS. Multiple categories may coexist. Failed/address subtypes are FAILED_ATTEMPT, ADDRESS_EXCEPTION or BOTH. TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE are distinct; missing facts are not false.

Physical failed attempts require valid ATTEMPT_FAILED event references and distinct attempt_id values within a shipment snapshot. Duplicate messages for one attempt count once. Missing identity/history leaves the affected count unknown. Complete history with zero failures and inactive address state has no failed/address exception. Failed-attempt history remains relevant until closure.

Each category owns classification, eligibility, evidence and blockers. A shipment-global blocker yields NEEDS_REVIEW. Otherwise use any READY_TO_ESCALATE, then any NEEDS_REVIEW, then any MONITOR, otherwise NORMAL. An unrelated unknown remains visible but cannot cancel an independently ready category. HIGH priority requires a verified eligibility trigger, MEDIUM applies to remaining review cases, LOW to remaining monitor/normal cases. Readiness is not operational approval.

One valid failed attempt with address known inactive is a confirmed exception to monitor when dependent evidence is complete. Do not invent a second attempt or infer recovery from subsequent movement.

With ADDRESS_ACTIVE_ESCALATES enabled, an explicit unresolved ADDRESS_EXCEPTION is immediately eligible. Immediate eligibility is not final readiness: address-based readiness still requires applicable common evidence, E-ADDRESS, and E-POLICY-SECTIONS support. Only a later explicit ADDRESS_CLEARED clears it; contradictory simultaneous markers are unknown. Marker history must establish the current state; incomplete marker history cannot prove no later clearance. Attempt IDs are not required for address-only support. Do not invent an address defect, cooldown, carrier procedure or recovery.

Unavailable or ambiguous required bundle is shipment-global. Missing/inconsistent required category sections block dependent decisions only. Exact active policy/version/section support is required; similarity scores do not establish policy authority. Supplemental-search misses are warnings when required support exists.
A confirmed late shipment below LATE_ESCALATE_HOURS is not yet escalation-eligible. With dependent evidence complete, monitor; otherwise review only the dependent late decision.

At gap >= STALE_ESCALATE_HOURS, stale tracking is eligible. Require last qualifying event reference/time/code, gap, history_complete=true and no relevant scan conflict, plus common and policy-section evidence. A missing promise does not block this independent decision. A new qualifying scan may end staleness; do not infer a delay cause.

At least FAILED_ATTEMPTS_ESCALATE unique valid failures meet eligibility. Require E-FAILED and common/policy-section evidence. Independent attempt-based readiness does not require address evidence unless an address decision is also claimed.

Late detection is as_of > promised_delivery_at on an open shipment; at equality it is not late. Compare exact elapsed seconds, round only for display. Missing/invalid promise is late-category UNKNOWN. Complete tracking history is not a dependency.
A confirmed late shipment below LATE_ESCALATE_HOURS is not yet escalation-eligible. With dependent evidence complete, monitor; otherwise review only the dependent late decision.

At hours_overdue >= LATE_ESCALATE_HOURS, the late trigger is eligible. Require common identity/status/policy context, E-LATE and E-POLICY-SECTIONS. A missing scan or attempt history does not block a fully evidenced late handoff. Draft only for human review.
